This route is still being explored. The Trail Atlas currently shows<\/a> only the section that I was able to verify during my most recent field visit.<\/p>\n\n\n\n

\n\n\n\n

The exploration took place in July 2026 with the goal of verifying a downloaded GPX route that appeared to form a loop around Campagao Peak. I followed the route to a pocket forest with a small residential settlement before deciding to turn back.<\/p>\n\n\n\n

After reaching the settlement, I asked several local residents about the continuation of the trail, but the directions I received were inconsistent. One steep trail appeared to continue uphill, although I could not confirm where it led or whether it connected to the intended loop. Rather than continue without verification, I returned by retracing the established Campagao Peak trail.<\/p>\n\n\n\n

Based on what I saw, the route may be easier to verify by approaching it from the opposite direction during a future field visit.<\/p>\n\n\n\n

The junction where this route branches from the Campagao Peak trail was faint and easy to miss, suggesting that relatively few people use it. A short distance beyond the junction, however, the trail became well-defined. I also noted that another trail may provide direct access to the pocket forest without passing through the Campagao Peak route.<\/p>\n\n\n\n

A future visit will require additional time. Dense vegetation and tree cover obscure the footpaths, making it difficult to verify the route using satellite imagery alone.<\/p>\n\n\n\n","protected":false},"featured_media":778,"template":"","trail_location":[64],"trail_feature":[],"trail_type":[],"trail_difficulty":[],"class_list":["post-775","trail","type-trail","status-publish","has-post-thumbnail","hentry","trail_location-minglanilla"],"_links":{"self":[{"href":"https:\/\/beesayatv.test\/wp-json\/wp\/v2\/trail\/775","targetHints":{"allow":["GET"]}}],"collection":[{"href":"https:\/\/beesayatv.test\/wp-json\/wp\/v2\/trail"}],"about":[{"href":"https:\/\/beesayatv.test\/wp-json\/wp\/v2\/types\/trail"}],"wp:featuredmedia":[{"embeddable":true,"href":"https:\/\/beesayatv.test\/wp-json\/wp\/v2\/media\/778"}],"wp:attachment":[{"href":"https:\/\/beesayatv.test\/wp-json\/wp\/v2\/media?parent=775"}],"wp:term":[{"taxonomy":"trail_location","embeddable":true,"href":"https:\/\/beesayatv.test\/wp-json\/wp\/v2\/trail_location?post=775"},{"taxonomy":"trail_feature","embeddable":true,"href":"https:\/\/beesayatv.test\/wp-json\/wp\/v2\/trail_feature?post=775"},{"taxonomy":"trail_type","embeddable":true,"href":"https:\/\/beesayatv.test\/wp-json\/wp\/v2\/trail_type?post=775"},{"taxonomy":"trail_difficulty","embeddable":true,"href":"https:\/\/beesayatv.test\/wp-json\/wp\/v2\/trail_difficulty?post=775"}],"curies":[{"name":"wp","href":"https:\/\/api.w.org\/{rel}","templated":true}]}}
